errors.text_span: червена линия, представляваща линията на бедност
errors.evidence: The red line represents the percentage of poor people after social transfers, not the poverty line. The poverty line is represented by the grey bars.

errors.text_span: която варира приблизително между 413 и 451 лв.
errors.evidence: The red line's values are read from the right y-axis and are in percentages (ranging from approximately 22% to 24%), not in BGN (лв.). The values 413 and 451 BGN belong to the bar chart for 2019 and 2020.

errors.text_span: Вдясно е представена стълбовидна графика, която показва процента на населението, живеещо под линията на бедност
errors.evidence: The bar chart (стълбовидна графика) represents the poverty line in BGN, corresponding to the left y-axis. The percentage of the population is shown by the red line chart, corresponding to the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: изразени като „В лв. (среден доход за бедност)” и "% от населението"
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the labels of the two different y-axes. The bar chart's unit is "В лв. (средномесечно)" and the line chart's unit is "В % от населението". The description also fabricates the phrase "среден доход за бедност".

errors.text_span: като той варира между 308 и 351 лв.
errors.evidence: The value of the bars (representing the poverty line) ranges from 308 BGN in 2016 to 451 BGN in 2020. The range 308-351 BGN only covers the years 2016-2018.

errors.text_span: и 23,0% от населението за съответната година
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence incorrectly appends a percentage value (which belongs to the line chart) to the description of the bar chart's variation (which is in BGN).
The red line spans the entire width of the chart. Using "Вляво" (On the left) is imprecise and confusing, especially as the line's values correspond to the right y-axis.
